changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE dropped RECORD; BEGIN FOR dropped IN SELECT cp.property_key, cp.scope, cp.property_value FROM configuration_properties cp WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM configuration_properties keeper WHERE keeper.property_key = cp.property_key AND keeper.id <> cp.id AND ((cp.scope IS NULL AND keeper.scope IS NOT NULL) OR ((cp.scope IS NULL) = (keeper.scope IS NULL) AND (keeper.updated_at, keeper.id) > (cp.updated_at, cp.id)))) LOOP RAISE NOTICE 'configuration_properties: dropping duplicate of % (scope=%, value=%); another row for this key survives the scope drop', dropped.property_key, coalesce(dropped.scope, '<none>'), dropped.property_value; END LOOP; END $$;

changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM configuration_properties cp WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM configuration_properties keeper WHERE keeper.property_key = cp.property_key AND keeper.id <> cp.id AND ((cp.scope IS NULL AND keeper.scope IS NOT NULL) OR ((cp.scope IS NULL) = (keeper.scope IS NULL) AND (keeper.updated_at > cp.updated_at OR (keeper.updated_at = cp.updated_at AND keeper.id > cp.id)))));

changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS uniq_key; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS uniq_key_scope;
